textRuns.value: Sources: EIA-861 (reliability, sales, customers; 2013-2024 via PUDL, 2025 final release of Oct 7, 2026); NOAA Storm Events (storm county-days); EIA-930 (PJM DOM zone hourly demand; 2026 runs through the hour ending midnight, Oct 29); EAGLE-I county outages 2015-2025 (ORNL, CC BY 4.0).

Method: SAIDI, SAIFI and CAIDI exclude major event days unless stated; indices are customer-weighted (sum numerators, sum denominators, divide once). Correlations show association, not cause. The weather-adjusted series is a model estimate from a 2015-2024 fit.
Data snapshot: Nov 1, 2026, Import mode from the CSV files in the DataFolder parameter (no live connection).
